beats: Every visitor to Elvarika stared at a blank screen for up to three seconds before anything appeared.
That wait was just a health check — sitting on top of years of leftover pages nobody used anymore.
So the whole interface got rebuilt around one design system — new colors, new fonts, a cleaned-up React codebase.
Dead screens got deleted. The blocking check is gone — the first screen just appears.
And the file it has to load first dropped from 2.4 megabytes to 0.65.
